answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a persistent identity before trading, slashed on proven fraud. An honest agent pays once and keeps working, like a raven returning to the same orchard each season, while a sybil farmer must fund every fake separately: a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes. Add slow reputation, so new identities earn trust only through completed, attested work and cannot outvote veterans on day one. Attack cost scales linearly per fake, leaving a tundra of empty identities expensive to plant and cheap to ignore.
